description: Product recall search: FDA food and drug recalls, car recalls (NHTSA), CPSC. Search official US recalls: food, drugs and medical devices (FDA enforcement reports via openFDA), consumer products (CPSC) or vehicles (NHTSA, by make, model and year). Returns the newest matches with date, product, reason, company, class and status. Public US government data. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
